_doc: ROOTCAUSE-1 (owner, 2026-11-21): the system audits every failure mode, names the ROOT cause of each finding and remediates it. Read by foundation/rootcause.py. A class is a root cause, not a symptom: `match` says which findings (by failure mode, kind or text) it explains, `root` is the earliest cause, `guard` is a file:/grep: probe proving the mechanism that makes the failure impossible exists, `remedy` is what the queue item asks the executor to build when it does not. A class seen on `escalate_days` distinct days inside `window_days` escalates from the symptom to its root: guard absent = build it, guard present = it is ineffective (incident, redesign). The item closes only when the guard passes AND the class stays quiet for `quiet_days`. A finding no class explains becomes Q-ROOT-unclassified.

classes.root: a step reported success from the call's own return value, not from reading the result back from the live system
classes.remedy: Every outward act (post, deploy, send) records done only after an independent live read-back; extend the read-back to the channel the false claim came from.

classes.root: a domain or account move changed where names resolve and nothing re-attached custom domains and proxied records
classes.remedy: The uptime worker redeploys the site when a name stops resolving; make the redeploy re-attach every custom domain and prove each resolves.

classes.root: a PR had no server-side owner that merges, reconciles or supersedes it
classes.remedy: Give the stuck PR's route a lane step that merges or supersedes it and a lanewatch probe that fails while one stands.

classes.root: a loop accepted an owner action as its next step without exhausting every other path
classes.remedy: Route the step through pathfinder (every surface tried, attempts recorded) and stage a default in effect.

classes.root: a link or route reached an owner-bound action without passing the sign-in check
classes.remedy: Put the route behind the shared owner-identity check and add a test that fetches it unauthenticated and expects a refusal.

classes.root: code was added under a top-level directory the policy does not know, so nothing runs or checks it
classes.remedy: Register the root in the same change that adds what runs it (doctrine/strays.json code_roots), or move the code.

classes.root: a file is rewritten by every change: either hand-kept state that should be computed or appended, or generated output the hotspot score counted as work (temporal now reads scripts/regen_generated.py OUTPUTS, one list, so a generator cannot be flagged)
classes.remedy: Make the value computed or the file append-only, so one change no longer rewrites it; the hotspot closes when its edits fall to baseline.

classes.root: no loop owns the area's upkeep, so work stopped when the area's first burst ended
classes.remedy: Give the area an advocate loop with a cadence and a growth item per run; attention weights lift neglected areas in the executor queue.

classes.root: two test files share a basename in different directories, so discovery imports the wrong one
classes.remedy: Rename one of the files; the unique-basename test keeps it from returning.

classes.root: a loop failed the same way again and no change altered the approach
classes.remedy: Apply the loop-breaker: change the tool, path or abstraction named in the item, not the retry count.

classes.root: a change reached main without its own checks proving it green on the code that merges
classes.remedy: Bisect to the first red commit and revert the smallest change (redmain); add the regression test the change lacked.

classes.root: a component of the unattended year is unmeasured or below target and no loop owns closing the gap
classes.remedy: Measure the component from live data and file the loop that closes it; an unmeasured component counts as below target.

classes.root: predictions were scored against outcomes without feeding the score back into the forecaster
classes.remedy: Recalibrate the forecaster from settled outcomes until its Brier score beats a coin.

classes.root: a fact the repository declares was applied once and never read back against the live system
classes.remedy: Read the live value on a clock and set it back to the declaration (DECLARED-LIVE-1).

classes.root: a back end's only route to run was its own cron, an account-wide quota nobody counted
classes.remedy: Give the back end a pulse URL in doctrine/topology.json; the tick calls it hourly.

classes.root: a push made with a run's own token starts no workflow, and nothing compared pushes with runs
state was written by the agent that wrote the code, not by a live reading
classes.remedy: Set the row back until its live probe shows evidence.
